purpose: Rough nominal SIM stage durations for the planning schedule preview only. Never actor control, stage-transition or success input.
unit: SIM seconds from the stage's first issued command to the next stage's first issued command
limits: Two synchronous open-map seed-11 runs only (one concurrent dock_a, one serial dock_b); both beam carries used north and both box carries used south, so durations are route-agnostic per dock.
An unobserved dock falls back to the mean of observed docks and is marked unobserved_dock_mean.
Realtime runs of the same scene show beam approach 48-121 s and beam carry 7-148 s; the spread is large.
box_carry_before_bay_fraction is an authored guess of where the box queues before the shared bay, not a measurement.

sources.plan: dock_a; beam r1+r3 north after=[]; box r2 south after=[]; concurrent (independent_open_routes)
dock_b; box r2 south after=[]; beam r1+r3 north after=[box_job]; one job at a time (agreed_dependencies_require_serial)
